value.rationale: The result determines the entire sharp ℓ1/ℓ∞ time-derivative norm of graph heat semigroups on the structurally important complete multipartite family, classifies when its dimension-dependent sharp bound is reached, and establishes an ordered hub-to-bulk shift in worst-case smoothing. The explicit nonisomorphic graphs with the same full endpoint norm profile but different Laplacian spectra give a concrete boundary to inverse inference from heat operator norms. These are naturally motivated and not merely a check of a numerical example; the result is not claimed for arbitrary graphs.
